scope: 416 original Markdown transcripts only; letters and essays unchanged
method: Document-level screening: all titles and opening excerpts read; full text scanned for contextual markers; ambiguous/exclusion cases receive targeted middle/end or full short-text reading. Not a sentence-by-sentence or audio/video audit.
user_policy: Exclude videos without Buffett participation and third-party commentary, including reaction videos that embed Buffett clips. Keep multi-person Buffett events. Brief introductions to primary clips do not alone imply commentary.
